## `POST /api/v1/ci-trust-rules`

Create a CI trust rule

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Answers 409 when an access file manages the scope; `override_managed` with `override_reason` overrides it (ADMIN on the instance; audited).

Creates an enabled rule that lets CI jobs whose ID-token claims match its conditions exchange them for a token that acts as a service account. Needs the `ADMIN` role on the instance. Answers 404 when the principal, environment or repository does not exist and 422 when a field breaks the rules of a trust rule.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `override_managed` | query | no | true or false | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency. Needs the ADMIN role on the instance and `override_reason`; audited, and shown as drift until the next apply. |
| `override_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line; with `override_managed=true`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `CiTrustRuleCreate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issuer` | text | yes |  |
| `principal` | text | yes |  |
| `environment` | text | yes |  |
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `kinds` | list of text | no |  |
| `conditions` | mapping of text to text | yes |  |
| `start_on_deploy_jobs` | true or false | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Successful Response | `CiTrustRuleOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `404` | What the request names does not exist, or the caller may not know that it does. | `ErrorOut` |
| `409` | The request conflicts with the current state; the message says what to change. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `CiTrustRuleOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `issuer` | text | yes |  |
| `principal` | text | yes |  |
| `environment` | text | yes |  |
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `kinds` | list of text | yes |  |
| `conditions` | mapping of text to text | yes |  |

## `POST /api/v1/ci-trust-rules/explain`

Explain which CI trust rule matches claims

Says which rule an exchange with the given ID-token claims would match, and why the others do not. Needs the `ADMIN` role on the instance. Answers 422 when no issuer is given and the claims have no `iss` text.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `CiTrustExplainIn`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claims` | mapping of text to any | yes |  |
| `environment` | text | yes |  |
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `issuer` | text or null | no |  |

Answers:

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Successful Response | `CiTrustExplainOut` |
| `401` | Not signed in: the token or browser session is missing, wrong, expired or revoked; an ended session says why in `reason`. | `ErrorOut` |
| `403` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this; the message says why and what to do next. | `ErrorOut` |
| `422` | Validation Error | `HTTPValidationError` |

Answer fields: `CiTrustExplainOut`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `issuer` | text | yes |  |
| `environment` | text | yes |  |
| `repository` | text | yes |  |
| `verdict` | text | yes |  |
| `matching` | list of text (uuid) | yes |  |
| `rules` | list of `CiTrustRuleExplanationOut` | yes |  |

## `PATCH /api/v1/ci-trust-rules/{rule_id}`

Change a CI trust rule

From the web interface it needs a passkey touch within the last 15 minutes (403 `StepUpRequired`); a token never does.

Answers 409 when an access file manages the scope; `override_managed` with `override_reason` overrides it (ADMIN on the instance; audited).

Changes the rule's principal, kinds, conditions or `start_on_deploy_jobs`. The tokens issued under it end. Needs the `ADMIN` role on the instance. Answers 404 when there is no such rule or principal and 422 when nothing is given or a field breaks the rules of a trust rule.

Parameters:

| Name | In | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rule_id` | path | yes | text (uuid) | The CI trust rule's id. |
| `override_managed` | query | no | true or false | Change access in a scope an access file manages anyway, in an emergency. Needs the ADMIN role on the instance and `override_reason`; audited, and shown as drift until the next apply. |
| `override_reason` | query | no | text or null | Why, 10 to 500 characters on one line; with `override_managed=true`. |
| `authorization` | header | no | text or null | The credential: `Bearer <token>` with a personal access token, task token or CI token. Without it, the web interface's session cookie counts instead. |

Request body (application/json, required): `CiTrustRuleUpdate`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `principal` | text or null | no |  |
| `kinds` | list of text or null | no |  |

## `POST /api/v1/ci-trust-rules/{rule_id}/disable`
